jobs.description:
Context & Environment

Application deadline: 11-11-2026

Contract type: Local, Esbjerg

Appetizer

Do you want to turn cybersecurity requirements into clear governance that people can actually follow? Are you excited by the challenge of protecting both enterprise and industrial environments? Do you enjoy partnering with stakeholders, asking the right questions, and driving risk-reducing actions through to completion? In this role, you will help implement cybersecurity policies and governance, ensuring compliance with company standards and regulatory requirements. If this sounds like the kind of impact you want to make, apply now and tell us what you would bring to the team.

Your new team

One IT Denmark delivers the IT and digital services that keep the business running onshore and offshore. We work closely with colleagues across the organization to improve reliability, introduce new solutions, and strengthen cybersecurity.

The department includes four teams: Business Partnering, IT Operations, Project & Performance, and Cybersecurity & Industrial. Together, we support TotalEnergies EP Denmark (TEPDK) and TotalEnergies Upstream Denmark (TUDK) operations and development projects.

In a department with different nationalities and backgrounds, we believe in the power of diversity and collaboration. People are the key to our success; we invest in development and foster an atmosphere of innovation.

Would you like to help shape better energy?

Send your application as soon as possible. For any questions, you are more than welcome to reach out to Human Resources (HR) Recruitment on ep.dk-recruitment@totalenergies.com.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Activities

Key areas of responsibility

Cybersecurity governance and support

• Help shape and maintain local cybersecurity governance, aligned with group standards and Danish regulations, across both enterprise and industrial systems

• Turn security requirements into practical guidance, templates, and ways of working that teams can apply in day-to-day operations

• Support incident response by investigating and following up on cybersecurity incidents, working with central Headquarters (HQ) teams, local teams, and external service providers.

• Perform systematic vulnerability assessment and vulnerability management

• Assist definition and follow-up on cybersecurity requirements in 3rd party contracts to manage supply chain related risks.

Cybersecurity risk assessment activities

• Manage cybersecurity risk assessment activities

• Identify gaps against security requirements and agree on feasible remediation actions with system owners and business stakeholders

• Build and track remediation plans for vulnerabilities and approved exceptions, and report progress to stakeholders

• Advise project teams and vendor/contract owners on cybersecurity requirements and risk-reducing controls

Operational procedures and security

• Help define and improve security procedures and technical controls (hardware and software) to reduce risk

• Strengthen incident readiness and response by helping define roles, playbooks, tooling, training and supporting response activities during major incidents

• Contribute to training, presentations, and communications to raise cybersecurity awareness in the organization

• Collaborate with teams in central Headquarters (HQ) and other affiliates and share feedback from the Denmark organization

What we offer

At TotalEnergies, we believe that our people are our greatest strength. Joining us means becoming part of a diverse global organization where expertise, innovation, and collaboration drive our success. We offer opportunities to develop your skills, grow your career, and contribute to the energy transition while benefiting from a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package.

Total Rewards Package

As part of our commitment to fair and transparent remuneration practices, the base salary range for this position is DKK 669,750 - DKK 893,000 annually, reflecting the expected level and scope of the role.

In addition to the base salary, we offer an annual performance-based bonus, pension contribution, employee share ownership program participation, wellbeing and insurance benefits, flexible working practices, training and development opportunities.

The final salary offer will be determined based on objective criteria such as qualifications, relevant experience, competencies, role scope, responsibilities, organizational needs, and market alignment.

Candidate Profile

Who we are looking for

• BSc in Information Security (or similar) or at least 10 years of IT experience

• Minimum 5 years of cybersecurity experience

• Knowledge of, and preferably practical experience with, NIS2 directive related Danish Executive Order on resilience and preparedness in the energy sector (No. 260)

• Experience with Industrial Information Systems / Operational Technology (OT) environments is an advantage

• Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to translate requirements into practical guidance

• Structured, analytical approach to risk-, incident-, and vulnerability management

**_Ready to build the AI engine behind the world's largest jewellery brand?

_**As Lead AI Platform Engineer, you will be the technical force behind Pandora's AI platform, shaping how AI systems are built, scaled, and secured across the business. Combining deep hands-on engineering expertise with strong technical leadership, you will drive architectural excellence, elevate engineering standards, and deliver reliable, production-ready AI solutions at scale.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Be To

****Technical Leadership

**

• Serve as the technical lead for the AI platform engineering team — setting the implementation direction, defining coding standards, and making key technical decisions that govern how the platform is built and evolved.

• Lead code reviews and drive architecture discussions, ensuring engineering decisions are well-reasoned, documented, and aligned with the broader platform strategy — championing engineering standards across code quality, testing practices, documentation, observability, and security hardening.

• Act as a technical mentor and go-to resource for all engineers — sharing knowledge, unblocking complex problems, and actively investing in the technical growth of both senior and junior team members.

**Platform Engineering & AI Infrastructure

**

• Design, build, and operate scalable, high-performance services and platform components that expose AI/ML capabilities across Pandora's digital ecosystem.

• Own and define the standards and governance for Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC) — ensuring all Azure infrastructure is reproducible, auditable, and securely configured.

• Apply strong network architecture knowledge to design and govern secure connectivity between platform services, AI gateways, and external integrations, including VNet, private endpoints, NSGs, and ingress/egress controls, while collaborating with security stakeholders to uphold the platform's overall security posture.

• Leverage Databricks for big data processing, feature engineering, and ML pipeline support.

**AI Services & Agentic Development

**

• Integrate and operationalise AI services including LLM APIs, vector search, RAG pipelines, embeddings, and multi-layer caching into platform-level services.

• Lead the agentic code development practice: architecting autonomous execution loops that enable tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to safely write, test, and self-correct software within isolated sandboxes.

• Own MLflow governance standards for experiment tracking, model versioning, and ML lifecycle management across the team.

• Configure and manage AI gateways to ensure secure, scalable, and governed access to AI capabilities at production scale.

**CI/CD & Reliability

**

• Define and govern the CI/CD standards for the AI platform team — establishing quality gates, testing frameworks, deployment patterns, and pipeline architecture that all engineers build to.

• Ensure performance, availability, and maintainability of platform services in production; handle incidents in a timely manner to minimise Mean Time to Contain (MTTC).

**Job Requirements

****Education & Experience

**

• Relevant background from Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field with experience in backend or platform engineering, with at least 2 years operating in a technical leadership capacity within AI or cloud-native platform teams.

• Proven experience building and operating AI/ML platform services or LLM-based integrations in a production environment.

**Technical Skills

**

• Strong backend engineering fundamentals: service architecture, REST API design, performance optimisation, and production reliability by design and monitoring, with hands-on proficiency in Python.

• Deep Kubernetes expertise — workload configuration, networking, security policy design, and production debugging; hands-on Docker and Azure App Services.

• Expert-level Terraform and IaC ownership — defining standards, patterns, and governance for cloud infrastructure on Azure.

• Strong network architecture and configuration skills, including Azure networking concepts (VNet, NSG, private endpoints, DNS, ingress/egress).

• MLflow governance, Databricks for ML pipeline integration, and experience with ML serving infrastructure, LLM APIs, prompt integration, and multi-layer caching.

• Proficiency in PostgreSQL and experience in configuring AI gateways for centralized AI governance

• Experience in agentic code development practice, harness engineering and spec-driven development is a plus.

**Soft Skills

**Ideally you are a trusted technical leader who combines strong engineering expertise with clear thinking and a collaborative approach to drive sound decisions, communicate complex platform, security, and architecture topics in a business-friendly way, and foster team growth. Brings a proactive and curious mindset, with a passion for emerging AI technologies balanced by a pragmatic focus on execution and delivery.

**About The Team

**You will be part of Pandora's AI Platform team within AI CoE at Digital & Analytics & AI — a passionate, forward-thinking group dedicated to building the infrastructure and services that bring AI to life across the business. The team works at the intersection of data science, machine learning, cloud engineering, and product development, collaborating closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Architects, and Product stakeholders.

You will report to the AI Platform Manager and serve as the senior technical voice that shapes how the platform is designed, secured, and evolved — influencing both what gets built and how it gets built.

**Did we get your attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s experience & ambitions.Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Working on behalf of RWS, you will test and evaluate how our clients’ search engine responds to everyday searches from everyday people.

**

**Work Benefits

**

At Weibel, you will join a rapidly growing, family-owned technology company where curiosity, innovation, and dedication form the foundation of our success. As our new Sub System Architect you will play a key role in shaping the design of our radar solutions. You will work alongside talented, committed colleagues who share a passion for technology.

We are expanding our team and are looking for a Sub System Architect to lead the architecture of key subsystems e.g., pedestals, trailers, cooling, or power from concept to verification. You will translate system needs into robust solutions, interfaces, and guide cross‑disciplinary design through specification, reviews, integration, and test. Verifying and developing designs is done by review, simulations, and prototyping.

Your impact

• Be responsible for the subsystem architecture: define purpose, scope, block diagrams, interfaces, BOM structure, and key design decisions.

• Requirements flow‑down & compliance: allocate system requirements to subsystem level, maintain compliance matrices/SoC, and support traceability through design, test, and verification.

• Interface leadership: specify and manage interfaces to neighboring subsystems and external equipment and ensure early alignment.

• Design coordination: collaborate with engineering disciplines Mechanical, Electrical and Software, to meet performance, reliability, maintainability, and safety requirements.

• Risk & change control: identify technical risks, propose mitigations, and manage changes while safeguarding architectural integrity.

• Integration & verification: support build, bring-up, test planning, environmental testing (shock, vibration, thermal), and verification reports.

• Reviews & communication: prepare architecture packages and lead design reviews. Communicate decisions and rationales to stakeholders, and ensure documentation is clear and ready for review.

Your background and experience

• BSc/MSc in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or similar.

• Solid systems engineering mindset and preferably a few years of experience from a similar role.

• Experience with functional decomposition, interfaces, requirements, verification/validation, and standards.

• Ability to create clear technical documentation and lead collaborative reviews.

Your new team

In our R&D department you will join more than 270 highly competent and dedicated colleagues. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do, ensuring a seamless transition from design to production. We are dedicated to the ongoing refinement of our processes and the strategic integration of new technologies. We wholeheartedly believe that bringing people with different competencies together will generate the best solutions.

Contact and application

Please apply at our website using the ”Apply” button. The application can be in Danish or English. If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact Director, Hans Plessing on hap@weibel.dk

The deadline is 16th of November 2026, but we review the applications on an ongoing basis.

Please be aware that it is a requirement for this position that you can provide a criminal record with no remarks and obtain a security clearance.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Bliv en del af en dansk virksomhed

Weibel Scientific A/S er en danskejet ingeniørvirksomhed i kraftig vækst. Vi udvikler og producerer højteknologiske radarer til brug i bl.a. rumforskning, flyindustri, forsvar samt beskyttelse af kritisk infrastruktur. Vores hovedkvarter ligger i Allerød og beskæftiger knap 600 medarbejdere.

I Weibel kan du se frem til et spændende og udfordrende job i en dynamisk og fremtidsorienteret virksomhed med in-house produktion og højteknologisk udvikling.

Læs også meget mere om os på vores hjemmeside.

Challenges you will work on

Do you thrive in an environment where analysis, planning, and operational decision-making go hand in hand?

As a Flight Dispatcher at SAS, you will play a key role in our flight operation. Working closely with pilots and colleagues in the Operations Control Center, you will be responsible for flight planning, operational follow-up, and support for our intercontinental operations. This role is well suited to someone who is motivated by responsibility, collaboration, and making well-informed decisions in a business that operates around the clock.

SAS Flight Dispatch is part of the SAS Operations Control Center, offering a dynamic environment where no two days are the same.

Your responsibilities include

• Preparing flight plans and operational documentation for SAS' intercontinental flights.

• Performing analyses and weight calculations for range-critical routes.

• Working with Flow Management to support an efficient flight operation.

• Monitoring flights and ensuring continuous operational follow-up.

• Providing operational support to pilots and operational management.

To be successful, we believe you have

• Valid Scandinavian FOO (K) licence or equivalent.

• Valid ATPL licence or completed ATPL theoretical training.

• For candidates whose highest qualification is completed ATPL theory, a passing result in the Danish Civil Aviation Authority's Flight Dispatcher examination is required before permanent employment can be offered.

• Relevant experience from the aviation industry.

• Fluency in written and spoken English and at least one Scandinavian language (Danish, Norwegian, or Swedish).

You thrive in an operational environment where the pace can be high and conditions can change quickly. With a structured approach and the ability to prioritize, you maintain an overview even when handling several tasks simultaneously.

As a Flight Dispatcher, you are a team player who values close collaboration and clear communication. You work closely with pilots, colleagues in the Operations Control Center, and other stakeholders to ensure that the right information reaches the right people at the right time. You actively contribute to joint solutions, take a service-minded approach, and understand the importance of collaboration in supporting a safe and efficient flight operation.

You are flexible, adaptable, and enjoy working in an organization that operates 24/7, 365 days a year.

Our Culture at SAS

At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you’ll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!

• Deadline for application: 06/11/2026. Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Note that we are not able to handle any applications that are sent by email, due to GDPR regulations.

• Position: Fulltime (100%) starting with a 3-month probation period

• Working hours are arranged as a rotating 3-shift schedule. SAS Flight Dispatch operates 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

• The position is based at the SAS Operations Control Center at Copenhagen Airport.

• To be eligible for this position you need an EU-work permit. Please note that we ask you to inform us if you currently have a valid EU-work permit.

• A background check will be conducted at the final stage of this recruitment process, as this role is security classified. If you, are aware of any specific matters that may come up during this background check, we kindly ask you to be transparent about them during the recruitment process.

For questions about the position, please contact Head of SAS Flight Dispatch, Michael Kok, by phone at +45 32 32 22 73 or by email at michael.kok@sas.dk. Please note that, due to GDPR regulations, we do not accept applications via email.

Project Manager for Real Estate and Facility Management

Join SAS on an Exciting Journey as a Project Manager for Real Estate & Facility Management

As Project Manager Real Estate & Facility Management at SAS, you will be responsible for leading and delivering real estate, workplace, refurbishment, and construction projects across Copenhagen and Copenhagen Airport. You will manage projects from concept and planning through execution and handover, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and according to business requirements.

Working closely with SAS Head of Real Estate, service partners, landlords, airport authorities, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders, you will play a key role in developing and transforming SAS real estate portfolio.

The role acts as the primary project lead and local REFM representative in Copenhagen, serving as the central point of coordination between stakeholders, suppliers, airport authorities, and the wider REFM organization.

Challenges you will work on:

Project Management & Delivery

• Lead workplace, refurbishment, construction, and facility-related projects across SAS locations in Copenhagen and Copenhagen Airport.

• Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, risks, and stakeholder expectations throughout the project lifecycle.

• Ensure projects are delivered according to agreed timelines, budgets, quality standards, and business requirements.

• Prepare project plans, business cases, progress reports, and decision-making material for stakeholders and management.

Construction & Technical Projects

• Coordinate and manage consultants, architects, contractors, and other external project resources.

• Oversee construction activities, site inspections, and project implementation.

• Ensure compliance with Danish construction regulations, airport requirements, health and safety standards, and internal governance.

• Review technical solutions, drawings, project documentation, and contractor deliverables.

Stakeholder & Supplier Management

• Act as the primary local point of contact for project-related REFM activities in Copenhagen.

• Coordinate project activities with landlords, airport authorities, suppliers, consultants, and internal business stakeholders.

• Build and maintain strong relationships to ensure alignment, support, and successful project execution.

• Lead project meetings and communicate progress, risks, and decisions to relevant stakeholders.

Financial & Commercial Management

• Develop and manage project budgets, forecasts, and cost follow-up.

• Support procurement activities, tender processes, and contract negotiations.

• Monitor project costs and identify opportunities for value engineering and cost optimization.

• Manage project changes, variations, and commercial discussions with suppliers and contractors.

Portfolio Development & Workplace Improvements

• Support the development and execution of the REFM project portfolio in Copenhagen.

• Drive workplace improvements, office transformations, and facility upgrades that enhance employee experience and operational efficiency.

• Identify opportunities to improve space utilization, sustainability performance, and overall workplace functionality.

• Contribute to strategic real estate and facility initiatives across the SAS portfolio.

The Team

You will be part of the SAS Real Estate & Facility Management (REFM) organization, collaborating with colleagues across Scandinavia to develop and deliver workplace, facility, and real estate projects that support both employees and business objectives.

SAS REFM manages approximately 260,000 sqm of leased and owned space, overseeing workplace services, lease agreements, renovations, construction projects, facility operations, and stakeholder relations. Our ambition is to provide sustainable, cost-effective, and attractive workplaces while supporting SAS's strategic development and operational needs.

As part of a close-knit Scandinavian team, you will work across borders and functions, leading projects and contributing to the development of workplaces and facilities that support the future of SAS.

To be successful we believe you have

• 5+ years of experience within project management, construction, real estate, facility management, workplace development.

• Relevant education within Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Real Estate, Facility Management, or equivalent.

• Proven experience managing construction, fit-out, refurbishment, workplace, or facility projects from planning through execution.

• Strong understanding of construction processes, project governance, procurement, and contract management.

• Experience managing contractors, consultants, suppliers, and multiple stakeholders simultaneously.

• Knowledge of Danish construction regulations, building standards, and health and safety requirements.

• Experience from an airport, transportation, logistics, property, or another complex operational environment is an advantage.

• Strong financial understanding with experience managing project budgets, forecasts, and cost control.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills.

• A proactive, structured, and solution-oriented mindset with strong leadership capabilities.

• Excellent communication skills in English and Danish. Swedish is an advantage.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management tools.

• Ability to work independently while driving multiple projects in a dynamic environment.

• Proven relationship-building skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across all organizational levels.

• A high level of ownership, commercial awareness, and commitment to delivering results.

Why SAS?

Join a globally recognized and dynamic organization where your work has a direct impact on the daily experience of employees and visitors.

This permanent position in Copenhagen offers wellness programs, pension plans, staff discounts, and a supportive workplace culture that values collaboration, development, and continuous improvement.

Our Culture at SAS

jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

_________

What if we didn’t focus on who you are now, but who you could become?

Are you ready to shape the future? Join us at EY as a Graduate in Technology Risk, starting August 2027. We focus on your potential and provide a supportive environment to enhance your professional and personal skills.

The opportunity: your next adventure awaits

As a Graduate in Technology Risk, you will join our Assurance team and work closely with IT managers, CFOs, CTOs, and CISOs across industries. Our team consists of 35 colleagues with diverse educational and cultural backgrounds.

We are looking for analytical and structured individuals with an interest in IT audits, information security, risk management, and IT strategy. Your work will include:

• 
IT audits and risk assessments: Interview stakeholders, understand business and IT processes, test controls, analyse documentation and data, and contribute to reports and recommendations.

• 
IT General Controls and IT Environment Audits: Evaluate IT controls and identify risks related to financial reporting, compliance, and governance frameworks such as ISO 27001 and COBIT.

• 
Service Provider and Technical Platform Audits: Assess controls across service providers, operating systems, databases, and networks.

• 
Data Protection and Security: Support clients with GDPR compliance, information security assessments, and security maturity evaluations.

• 
Technical Platform Audits: Conduct technical reviews of operating systems, databases, and networks, linking technical aspects to business processes.

• 
Emerging Risk Areas: Work with topics such as AI, cybersecurity, cloud governance, DORA, NIS2, ESG, and third-party risk management.

We offer a range of experiences to help you grow in a personalized manner, fostering a culture of global teamwork. You will be surrounded by dedicated colleagues in an inclusive environment, with opportunities for social events to strengthen team cohesion.

Our internal coaching and training programs will equip you with the skills needed to remain relevant in the future, while you build a network of colleagues and mentors at EY.

To learn more about our various teams within Assurance, please visit our career page.

What we look for

• 
You have a growth-focused mindset. We value how you absorb information, learn and take action just as much as the skills you have gained through education and experience.

• 
You are curious and purpose-driven. You see opportunities rather than obstacles and ask insightful questions that help build a better working world.

• 
You are inclusive. You are actively seeking and valuing diverse perspectives, appreciating differences, and collaborating to create a foundation of safety and trust.

• 
Qualifications:

• 

• You completed your studies in 2026 or are set to graduate in 2027.

• 

• You speak and write English fluently.

• 

• You hold, or expect to complete before joining, a relevant master’s degree within IT, information security, auditing, finance, data science, cybersecurity or a related field. You speak and write both Danish and English fluently, enabling you to communicate clearly with clients and colleagues.

What’s in it for you

• 
An exciting introductory program with all new graduates in the Nordics.

• 
A safe onboarding by your own personal buddy and counselor.

• 
Flexible and hybrid-working conditions, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.

• 
Highly collaborative teams and great support of a network of knowledgeable colleagues.

•

As our new Team Lead, you will take responsibility for the daily coordination, technical quality, and performance of a team of six skilled employees in Denmark and one in Turkey.

You will be expected to provide clear direction, establish priorities, and ensure that decisions are translated into action. At the same time, you will remain actively involved in engineering activities, contributing your own technical expertise to complex challenges and important projects.

An important part of your role will be to drive standardization, increase automation of engineering processes, and identify opportunities for cost optimization, helping us create more efficient, scalable, and competitive hardware solutions.

You will work closely with colleagues across Automation, Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, and Production, where your ability to communicate clearly, challenge constructively, and stand firm on technical quality and safety will be essential.

You will report to the Global Head of Automation and play an important role in strengthening the performance and capabilities of our Global Engineering & Automation organization.

• Lead with clarity and accountability: Set clear expectations, establish priorities, make decisions, and ensure that commitments are followed through.
• Drive technical execution: Take an active role in electrical design, panel engineering, component selection, BOM development, and technical problem-solving.
• Ensure high technical standards: Review and challenge electrical solutions, maintain compliance with safety requirements, and ensure consistent engineering quality and documentation.

• The opportunity to influence technical decisions, engineering standards, and ways of working.
